sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the non-CP alternative: the current sh:not containing sh:hasValue on the propellerType property shape does not reliably assert that the literal value is not exactly "CP" and can allow CP cases to pass when the CP branches fail. Replace it with an exact value exclusion, such as a correctly scoped SHACL-SPARQL constraint or an equivalent pattern that excludes only the complete value "CP" (without excluding valid non-CP values or permitting accidental CP matches). Also do not require pitchValueKnown globally for non-CP ships; constrain it within the CP alternatives unless its universal presence is independently required.
